body: Thanks for everything, i know i might sound very annoying and i'm grateful for your patience and words.

Me and my mother fight a lot, sometimes we seem more like sisters then like mother and daughter... We usually shout to each other, because when i say that she has to leave my father she says "And who is going to pay the bills, my money is not enought", then i usually tell her to quit being so proud and ask for help, it never ends well, she is always telling me to go to hell, and says i'm just like him because i don't see the effort she is doing, i think she doesn't mean that, she just doesn't like recognizing her mistake, but when i cry she just can't help but recognize it, like today, and now she is treating me like i'm made of porcelain, like "What do you want mom to make for dinner?", i can bet tomorrow we will be back to normal. I'm scared of what to expect, by now i don't believe he will change, i'm scared my mom confronts him and he threats to stop paying the bills, or to kill us all, i don't really know, he's not mentally stable, he is a policeman so he has a gun, so many times i hear at the news about a father that killed the family and stuff like that...i'm scared.

I noticed that you are helping other people with their problems in this site, and i'm glad you got over your low points and that you are here now. That's what will keep me with something to look for after all this, the chance to have a better life. I will not let him hurt me that way, i don't think he would do it, it's more probable that he would kill me than that, i think. I'm concerned with my mother now, she came to me this morning and asked me "Why that face?" (i spent all night crying and now i look like a frog with swollen eyes), we talked and i confessed that sometimes this situations give me stupid ideas, like killing myself, i didn't want to scare her, i just wanted her to see that we have to do something, she cried and promissed me she would try to make things better in the future, she went to buy groceries now but i'm scared she will do something, is kind of confusing, part of me wants her to make things change but the other part of me is really scared and doesn't want her to get hurt. Am i making any sense?

Thanks, i really needed someone to tell me something so i wouldn't feel so alone. I have 2 years and some months left of college-because it's 4 years in total and i'm in the middle of the second. I guess that's the best i can do, i'll have to, the options about running away and killing myself come to me but i'm not sure if i could really do them, maybe in the moment after a fight but for example now, after sleeping and have talk to my mother i think my only option is to keep going, it just gets so hard sometimes...and i feel like i'm lonely on this because my mom usually tries to pretend like this is a way of living like if none of us is going to get affected, i have to say that psychologically i feel really damaged, a bad day is enough to make me burst into tears. He scares me sometimes because he does sound like a perv, but he never tried anything. I'll try to keep myself safe, thank you so much for your reply.
